name: Fog Bank
oracle_text:
Defender (This creature can't attack.)
Flying
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature.

needs.what: a dealer filter (`damage_source`) on the `prevent_damage` static, so that `{"effect": "prevent_damage", "prevent_all": true, "combat_only": true, "damage_source": {"self_only": true}}` prevents all combat damage this creature would deal to any recipient (creatures, players and planeswalkers alike); the 'dealt to' half is already a second static with `affects: {"self_only": true}`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `prevent_damage` static with `prevent_all` + `combat_only` reads only the recipient (`affects`, via `prevents_all_damage`), so it covers 'dealt to this creature' but never 'dealt by' it. `damage_source` filters the dealer but the loader accepts it only on `replace_damage`, whose `damage_multiplier` must be 2 or more and so cannot prevent. `prevent_all_but` caps by recipient too. Writing only the 'dealt to' half would leave Fog Bank dealing combat damage, a different card.
